digest.component_or_area: helper function consolidation across rebar modules
propositions: Three token-identical definitions of _shadow exist across _mcp_writes.py, _mcp_reads.py, and _mcp_llm.py, plus a variant in _lib_ops.py that accepts explicit repo_root parameter
Three token-identical argparse converter functions named _positive_int exist in request.py, bridge.py, and reconcile.py that raise ArgumentTypeError for non-positive input
An out-of-scope namesake _positive_int in _config_resolvers.py returns a default value instead of raising, making it semantically distinct from the argparse twins

Consolidation requires a single shared _shadow(surface, repo_root=None) in _operation_config.py serving all four call sites, a single _positive_int converter in _cli/_parsers/_common.py, and _ticket_id moved to step_contracts.py
Guard test must verify exactly one definition of each helper under src/rebar and that all call sites route through the consolidated version
